QuestInfo.0: You have defeated all the enemies that Isaac requested. Can you enter the village now? Talk to Isaac and find out.
QuestInfo.1: Isaac demands more enemies be defeated before he'll let you through. Go to the #bForest of Pain#k and defeat #bFrozen Anxieties and Frozen Vanities#k.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated all the enemies that Isaac requested. It looked like he was going to ask for more, but some soldier called him over.

0.0: That's the trick! We've defeated a lot of these monsters, thanks to you. Ha, and THAT'S why I'M in charge!\r\n#L0# #bGreat. Can I get into town now?#l\n#k
0.1: Hold your dang horses! Get rid of some enemies, and I'll let you through.\r\n#L0# #bThat wasn't the deal, man!#l\n#k
0.2: Well, Kritias is on the verge of a crisis! Isn't this an emergency situation? All you gotta do is defeat some #bFrozen Anxieties and Frozen Vanities#k. Do this one simple thing, and I'll let ya through. Deal?

yes.0: That's the spirit! Just smash up some #bFrozen Anxieties and Frozen Vanities#k.
yes.1: You remember where the #bForest of Pain#k is, don't ya? Just head right.

no.0: What can we do when we're short on defense? If you succeed, I'll make sure you're rewarded accordingly. Okay? Please?

0.msg: #bYou'll let me in, now, right. Right?!#k

1.msg: Not so fast. You did good, but I got more work for you. This time, I want...

0.msg: Isaac, there's a message for you from Blundell!

item.0: It ain't rocket surgery. Head to the #bForest of Pain#k and defeat the #bFrozen Anxieties and Frozen Vanities#k to get the items. The #bForest of Pain#k is to the right of here.
